entities.nextSteps: 1. Check eligibility. 2. Register with UAE Pass where required. 3. Apply through the relevant MOCE programme. 4. Submit documents. 5. Await assessment and decision.
entities.timingAndFees: Processing times depend on the programme; marriage-grant deadlines are six months for application and three months for documents.
entities.applicantInformation: Primarily eligible UAE nationals; eligibility depends on income, family and social circumstances
entities.boundaryNote: Do not determine eligibility, submit applications, or access welfare records; direct users to official MOCE channels.

entities.lifeEventServices: Elderly Happiness and Home Care (Weleef); senior support and community services in Dubai
entities.documentsToPrepare: Senior’s Emirates ID; medical/care-needs information; family/caregiver details; supporting documents requested by CDA
entities.nextSteps: 1. Identify the care need. 2. Contact CDA or the relevant Dubai service. 3. Submit required information. 4. Follow assessment and service arrangements.
entities.timingAndFees: Not specified on the cited official page; confirm eligibility and availability with CDA.
entities.applicantInformation: Dubai residents and eligible seniors; service availability may vary by programme
entities.boundaryNote: Do not submit care applications or access care records; direct users to CDA’s official channels.

entities.lifeEventServices: Death reporting, police report, morgue transfer, police NOC, burial permit and forensic/prosecution-related procedures
entities.documentsToPrepare: Deceased’s Emirates ID/passport; hospital or police documents; morgue declaration; family member’s ID; forensic/prosecution documents for unnatural deaths
entities.nextSteps: 1. For an out-of-hospital death, call 999 immediately. 2. Obtain the police report and morgue documentation. 3. Obtain police NOC and burial permit. 4. For unnatural death, obtain forensic report and Public Prosecution letter. 5. Proceed to death-certificate issuance and burial.
entities.timingAndFees: Report out-of-hospital deaths immediately; burial-permit requirements differ for natural and unnatural deaths.
entities.applicantInformation: Families, legal representatives and authorised persons reporting a death in the UAE
entities.boundaryNote: Do not report deaths, access police records, or submit police applications; direct users to police on 999 and official police channels.

entities.lifeEventServices: Burial arrangements, cemetery procedures and local burial requirements
entities.documentsToPrepare: Death certificate/morgue declaration; police NOC; burial permit; deceased’s ID; family member’s ID
entities.nextSteps: 1. Obtain death and police documentation. 2. Obtain the burial permit. 3. Contact the relevant cemetery/municipality. 4. Arrange burial according to religious and local requirements.
entities.timingAndFees: Obtain permits before burial; cemetery charges and procedures vary by emirate.
entities.applicantInformation: Families and authorised representatives arranging burial in the UAE
entities.boundaryNote: Do not book burial services or access cemetery records; direct users to the relevant municipality/cemetery.

entities.entityName: UAE courts, notaries and asset-registration authorities
entities.lifeEventServices: Inheritance/succession procedures, wills, asset transfer, property, vehicle, bank and insurance updates
entities.documentsToPrepare: Death certificate; deceased’s ID/passport; heirs’ IDs/passports; marriage and birth certificates; will/succession documents; asset ownership documents
entities.nextSteps: 1. Obtain the death certificate. 2. Identify assets and liabilities. 3. Obtain succession/inheritance documents. 4. Apply to the relevant court/notary or asset authority. 5. Update bank, property, vehicle, insurance and utility records.
entities.timingAndFees: No single official deadline; act promptly to avoid account restrictions and asset-transfer delays.
entities.applicantInformation: Heirs, executors, legal representatives and beneficiaries; procedures vary by religion, nationality, will and asset type
entities.boundaryNote: Do not file inheritance cases, verify heirs, or access asset records; direct users to the relevant court/notary/asset authority.
